def solution():
    # Define variables
    closing_prices = [150, 152, 149, 153, 155, 154, 157, 159, 158, 160, 162, 161, 163, 164]
    low_prices = [148, 150, 147, 150, 151, 153, 156, 156, 157, 158, 159, 160, 161, 162]
    high_prices = [153, 155, 152, 155, 157, 156, 160, 162, 161, 164, 165, 164, 166, 167]
    period = 14

    # Do math calculation to get the answer
    period_low = min(low_prices[-period:])
    period_high = max(high_prices[-period:])
    recent_close = closing_prices[-1]

    stochastic_oscillator = (
        (recent_close - period_low) / (period_high - period_low)
    ) * 100

    answer = round(stochastic_oscillator, 2)

    # return answer
    return answer
